product.title: A fost odată. 24 de povești terapeutice
product.description: Cu aceste 24 povești terapeutice, Gilles Diederichs propune o abordare inovatoare a poveștii de seară: • Subiectele poveștilor sunt inspirate din viața de zi cu zi a copilului și îi permit să-și exprime fricile, supărările, coșmarurile, lipsa de încredere în sine și sentimentele legate de abandon sau de singurătate… • Copilul participă activ la lectură, ceea ce îi întărește legătura cu părinții. • Exercițiile de respirație și micile mișcări de masaj pe care le are de făcut copilul ritmează lectura. • Sfârșitul poveștii este ales special pentru a-l face să adoarmă netulburat, pe aripi de poezie. Pentru a adormi netulburat, pe aripi de poezie! GILLES DIEDERICHS este muzicoterapeut, specialist în sofrologie și relaxologie, compozitor de muzică de relaxare și autor a numeroase cărți de dezvoltare a copilului. Cu o experiență de 20 de ani în lucrul cu copiii, autorul activează în prezent, cu sprijinul Ministerului Educației, și în școlile din Franța, unde învață cadrele didactice noi tehnici și abordări în relaționarea cu elevii.

# A Fost Odata: 24 Therapeutic Stories for Children

Discover a unique journey into emotional well-being with *A fost odatÄ. 24 de poveÈti terapeutice*, a collection designed to support children's emotional growth and self-expression. Published by Litera, this book offers an innovative approach to bedtime stories that blends captivating narratives with practical therapeutic techniques.

## A Journey of Emotional Healing

This collection of 24 therapeutic stories, created by Gilles Diederichs, provides a safe and engaging space for children to explore complex feelings. The subjects of these stories are inspired by everyday childhood experiences, allowing children to safely address common emotional challenges such as fears, worries, nightmares, lack of self-confidence, and feelings of abandonment or loneliness.

### Interactive Storytelling for Deeper Connection

What sets these stories apart is the active participation of the child in the reading experience. The structure is designed not just for listening, but for engagement:

*   **Emotional Expression:** Stories enable children to articulate their fears and feelings in a gentle context.
*   **Parent-Child Bonding:** Active participation strengthens the bond between the child and their parents or caregivers.
*   **Relaxation Techniques:** The reading is seamlessly interwoven with soothing practices. Breathing exercises and gentle massage movements are synchronized with the rhythm of the story, promoting deep relaxation before sleep.

## Expertise Behind the Stories

The author, Gilles Diederichs, brings a wealth of expertise to this work. He is a music therapist, specializing in hypnotherapy and relaxology, and is also a composer of relaxation music. With 20 years of experience working with children, Diederichs leverages his knowledge to create stories that are both beautiful and deeply therapeutic. He is currently active in schools across France, where he trains educators in new methods for relating to students.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the author of these therapeutic stories?**
A: The book was written by Gilles Diederichs, who is a music therapist, specialist in hypnotherapy and relaxology, and author of children's development books.

**Q: How do these stories help children?**
A: They provide a framework for children to safely explore difficult emotions like fear, loneliness, and insecurity, while incorporating relaxation techniques (breathing and massage) to promote calmness and better sleep.

**Q: Are the stories interactive?**
A: Yes, the stories are designed so that the child actively participates in the reading experience, which helps them connect with their feelings and their caregivers.
